author: Karl Rock
description:
Many people from Baluchistan migrate across Pakistan in search of better work opportunities, bringing their incredible culture with them. They are widely known for being hardworking, friendly, and deeply hospitable. This unique trait is called 'Mehman Nawazi', and it defines the way they welcome guests into their lives.

You will find many of them running local breakfast spots now, serving up the best eggs, parathas, and chai you can find. These restaurants have become a staple for their community and a testament to their warmth.
title: What Are Baloch People REALLY Like?
